name: basicinvoices
description: Open-source invoicing for solo consultants. Single-binary Node + SQLite app on Fly.io.
author: James Terry

scripts.start:e2e: NODE_ENV=test PORT=8081 DB_PATH=./data/e2e.sqlite SMTP_HOST= E2E_EMAIL_LOG=./data/e2e-emails.log BI_PDF_ENABLED=1 SUPER_ADMIN_EMAIL=admin@example.com BASE_URL=http://localhost:8081 SESSION_SECRET=e2e-test-secret-do-not-use-anywhere-else node server/index.js
scripts.db:reset: rm -f data/*.sqlite data/*.sqlite-* && npm run migrate
